canonical.subject: BX-BUD-RELIABILITY-EVENT-BACKLOG-COUNT
canonical.normative_statement: per-root normalized event backlog is measured as maximum at-most 256 count in the declared environments.
preconditions: The candidate manifest, governed fixture, environment fingerprints, tools, and required minimum sample capacity are available.
canonical.action: Drive the overload fixture above consumer rate and assert bounded admission, explicit coalescing or rejection, and retained ordering traces.
observable_results: Raw samples and statistical report satisfy the proposed threshold, variance, regression, freshness, and exception policies.
prohibited_results: A desktop-only observation, average without raw samples, stale baseline, or absent measurement is reported as a pass.

canonical.subject: BX-FAIL-COMPONENT
canonical.normative_statement: Contain failure to the governed boundary, render an accessible fallback, preserve sibling roots, report diagnostics, and dispose owned resources.
preconditions: The governed trigger can be injected deterministically: component evaluation raises or violates its contract.
canonical.action: Inject component evaluation raises or violates its contract and observe isolation, fallback, diagnostics, authority, focus, and cleanup through 1000 milliseconds.
observable_results: Contain failure to the governed boundary, render an accessible fallback, preserve sibling roots, report diagnostics, and dispose owned resources.
prohibited_results: Failure is swallowed, retries or queues become unbounded, state authority is confused, or owned resources survive the declared bound.

canonical.subject: BH-05 Component programming model and lifecycle

preconditions: All declared dependencies preceding BH-05 have accepted evidence or an explicit blocking record.
